quick_facts.sprint_goal: Replace the JSON wiki system with SQLite + MCP server. By end of sprint: all vibe AI agents use MCP tools for wiki reads/writes, wiki-app reads from SQLite, no more manual JSON file updates.
quick_facts.priority_note: Infrastructure sprint inserted between Sprint 4 (done) and Sprint 5 (planned). Fixes cross-cutting wiki inconsistency that taxes every future sprint. High ROI: 9 sprints remain.

content.tldr: 4-day infra sprint: build wiki-mcp/ (SQLite + MCP server with 14 tools), run JSON→SQLite migration, register MCP in Claude Code settings, refactor wiki-app to read from SQLite. At sprint end: AI agents use tools, not file reads.
why_this_sprint: Wiki inconsistency is a per-sprint overhead: 5–8 manual file updates per session, routinely incomplete
No transactions: partial updates leave dashboard/changelog/features out of sync after every close/open
No schema enforcement: JSON files silently have wrong shapes
buildSearchIndex() in wiki-app loops all 60 files sequentially — slow and fragile
Fixing before Sprint 5 means all 9 remaining sprints run with reliable wiki state

features_committed.title: SQLite + MCP Server Wiki Infrastructure
features_committed.rationale: Single-feature sprint for full focus. 14 tasks across P0/P1/P2.
tasks: T001 [P0/S]: wiki-mcp/ scaffold — package.json, TypeScript, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk + better-sqlite3 + zod, stdio transport MCP server entry
T002 [P0/M]: schema.sql — features, sprints, tasks, api_contracts, bugs, history, decisions, changelog, audit_log tables + FTS5 virtual tables
T003 [P0/M]: migrate.ts — idempotent JSON→SQLite importer for all wiki/ files
T004 [P0/M]: Core read tools — wiki_dashboard, wiki_feature_get, wiki_feature_list, wiki_sprint_get, wiki_bug_list, wiki_contract_get
T005 [P0/M]: Core write tools — wiki_feature_update, wiki_task_update, wiki_session_log
T006 [P0/S]: Register MCP in .claude/settings.json — mcpServers entry, auto-approve wiki_* tools
T007 [P1/M]: Composite atomic tools — wiki_sprint_close(id), wiki_sprint_open(id) — single transaction
T008 [P1/S]: wiki_search(query, section?) — FTS5 full-text search, returns {section, id, title, snippet}
T009 [P1/S]: wiki_bug_create/update/list — auto-increment BUG-ID, Zod enum validation
T010 [P1/S]: wiki_contract_update — Zod endpoint shape validation, version auto-bump
T011 [P1/M]: Update vibe skill prompts — replace file-read/write patterns with MCP tool calls
T012 [P2/M]: Add better-sqlite3 to wiki-app, create lib/db.ts replacing lib/wiki.ts
T013 [P2/M]: Replace readWikiFile() in wiki-app page components with SQL queries
T014 [P2/S]: wiki-app admin API route — patchWikiFile() → SQL UPDATE via better-sqlite3

risks.risk: better-sqlite3 requires native compilation on Windows
risks.mitigation: Use better-sqlite3 pre-built binaries. Fallback: sql.js (pure JS WASM, no native build needed)

risks.risk: MCP server stdio config may require testing against actual Claude Code session before all 14 tools are built
risks.mitigation: T001 includes a single ping/echo tool to verify connection before proceeding to T004-T010

risks.risk: wiki-app and MCP server both opening wiki.db simultaneously may cause lock contention
risks.mitigation: PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL in db.ts — allows concurrent readers + one writer without blocking

definition_of_done: migrate.ts runs successfully against current wiki/ — all 60 JSON files imported to wiki.db
All 14 MCP tools return correct data verified against JSON source
MCP server registered in .claude/settings.json — wiki_* tools appear in Claude Code tool list
wiki-app type-check: 0 errors after lib/wiki.ts → lib/db.ts refactor
wiki-app loads dashboard, features, bugs, history pages from SQLite (verified in browser)
vibe-project-manager + vibe-qa-general skill prompts updated to call MCP tools
